title: moodboard.house/v1 semantic export
description: A house as a flat list of typed building elements (walls, slabs, windows, doors, a pool, boxes). Meant for an AI agent or a person who rebuilds the design in a BIM/CAD tool (Revit, ArchiCAD, ZWCAD). All lengths are in metres, all angles in degrees. Plan coordinates: x east, y north; z is elevation up; the ground is z = 0.

schema.description: Schema id and version of the document.

name.description: Name of the house or project; may be empty.

units.description: Units of every number in the document.

length.description: All lengths, areas (m2) and volumes (m3) derive from metres.

coordinateSystem.description: Human-readable statement of the axes: right-handed, z up, plan x east, y north, ground at z = 0 (the IFC and CAD convention).

generator.description: Name of the tool that wrote the document.

elements.description: Building elements. Order is not meaningful; windows and doors refer to their wall by id.

number.description: A finite number, rounded to 6 decimals.

positiveLength.description: A length in metres, greater than 0.

vec2.description: A plan point [x, y] in metres: x east, y north, on the ground plane.

vec3.description: A 3D vector [x, y, z]: x east, y north, z up.

material.description: The material of the element, with enough text to pick or create a matching material in the target tool.

id.description: Stable material id of the editor library.

category.description: Broad category, close to IFC material categories: plaster, concrete, glass, wood, water, ceramic, masonry, stone, metal, vegetation.

description.description: What the material stands for in a real building.

elementId.description: Unique element id. Windows and doors point to their wall with it.

elementName.description: Free label given by the author; may be empty.

wall.description: A wall: a polyline on the ground, extruded up by height and thickened around its centreline. Maps to IfcWall (Revit Wall, ArchiCAD Wall). Create one wall per straight segment, or one chain wall.

ifcClass.description: IFC class to use in the target tool.

points.description: Centreline polyline in plan, metres. Each consecutive pair is one straight segment; segment i runs points[i] to points[i + 1].

base.description: Elevation z of the wall bottom, metres.

thickness.description: Wall thickness, metres, centred on the centreline (half on each side).

axis.description: The points are the wall centreline, not an outer or inner face.

quantities.description: Computed quantities, so no one has to recompute them.

length.description: Total centreline length, metres (sum of all segments).

grossSideArea.description: length * height, square metres, one side, openings not subtracted.

volume.description: length * height * thickness, cubic metres, openings not subtracted.

openingIds.description: Ids of the windows and doors hosted by this wall.

opening.description: A window or door hosted by one straight segment of a wall. It cuts a rectangular opening in the wall.

geometry.description: Opening position and size relative to its host wall segment.

segment.description: Index of the host wall segment (points[segment] to points[segment + 1]).

offset.description: Distance in metres along that segment, from its start to the CENTRE of the opening.

width.description: Opening width along the wall, metres.

sill.description: Height of the opening bottom above the wall base, metres (0 for a door).

placement.description: Absolute placement, derived from the host wall.

point.description: Bottom centre of the opening on the wall centreline, metres: x, y from the segment at offset, z = wall base + sill.

direction.description: Unit vector along the host segment (the opening's width axis), with z = 0.

window.description: A window (IfcWindow) hosted by a wall.

ifcClass.description: IFC class to use in the target tool.

door.description: A door (IfcDoor) hosted by a wall; its sill is 0.

sill.description: A door starts at the wall base.

ifcClass.description: IFC class to use in the target tool.

slab.description: A horizontal slab (floor, terrace, roof plate) with a closed polygon outline. Maps to IfcSlab (Revit Floor, ArchiCAD Slab).

ifcClass.description: IFC class to use in the target tool.

outline.description: Closed outline in plan, metres. The last point is NOT repeated; the polygon closes itself.

elevation.description: Elevation z of the slab TOP, metres. The slab extends down by thickness.

area.description: Plan area of the outline, square metres (absolute shoelace value).

placedCenter.description: Centre of the rectangle in plan, metres.

placedWidth.description: Size along plan x before rotation, metres.

placedLength.description: Size along plan y before rotation, metres.

placedRotation.description: Rotation about the centre in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from above.

pool.description: A swimming pool: a rectangular basin sunk below the ground. No IFC pool class exists; use IfcBuildingElementProxy with ObjectType SwimmingPool (Revit: a mass or generic model; ArchiCAD: Morph).

ifcClass.description: IFC class to use in the target tool.

objectType.description: IFC ObjectType that tells what the proxy is.

depth.description: Water depth below the ground (z = 0), metres. The basin spans z = -depth to 0.

volume.description: width * length * depth, cubic metres of water.

box.description: A rectangular volume (a mass: roof block, planter, bench, annex). Use IfcBuildingElementProxy with ObjectType Volume (Revit: mass or generic model; ArchiCAD: Morph).

ifcClass.description: IFC class to use in the target tool.

objectType.description: IFC ObjectType that tells what the proxy is.

base.description: Elevation z of the box bottom, metres.
